strings: Finally after moons of feeling touch and go the fever has left m_c's pelt and {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} {VERB/m_c/feel/feels} better than ever.
Waking up m_c finally feels the relief of been in good health. No longer panting or whimpering, even the lingering rat bite seems to have healed.
m_c is so relieved to be able to get up out of the den and work once more. Even if that work is just clearing out {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} sickness scented bedding.
